rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child's regulatory-coordination provision. Both concern military decorations and assign rulemaking among service secretaries while requiring regulations to be uniform so far as practicable and subject to approval by the Secretary of Defense. C03 and C12 contain related interdepartmental uniformity machinery, but C08 combines the closest language with the same awards context.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The regulations prescribed by the Secretaries of the Army, Navy, and Air Force ... shall be uniform so far as practicable and shall be approved by the Secretary of Defense.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The regulations of the Secretary of the Navy and the regulations of the Secretary of the Army and the Secretary of the Air Force with respect to the award of the Purple Heart shall, so far as practicable, be of uniform application, and shall be subject to the approval of the Secretary of Defense.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel wording establishes uniform service regulations and Defense-level approval in the same military-decoration setting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Korean Service Medal, with suitable appurtenances, for award, under such regulations as the Secretaries ... may severally prescribe
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Navy shall award the Purple Heart ... [and] may issue such regulations as he may deem appropriate to effectuate the purposes of this order.
shared_material.explanation: Both directives couple rules for awarding a named military decoration with delegated regulatory authority.
